Increasing the strength of the individual trees decreases the forest error rate. --- Page 24 --- When Do I use A Random Forest Vs. Decision Tree? Random Forest Higher accuracy. Better generalization. Decision Tree Faster Easier to interpret. --- Page 25 --- What about Multiple Classes? • If we have more than 2 classes • the probability of each class is calculated • Select the highest as the algorithm final prediction. --- Page 26 --- Boosting • Co
